task_defect: The five-frame runs sent the full image and the text 'Point to each visible window.' The target building and the element type inside it were not passed as a region. Windows of a neighboring building or a vehicle cab satisfy that text. Those hits are a defect of the task, not a measured failure to localize a named region.

prompts_unchanged.window_opening: Point to each visible window opening.

crop_source: validation/model_selection/manifest.json crop_xyxy. These boxes were already on the diagnostic samples. They were not redrawn from model points.
crop_api: PIL Image.crop((x0, y0, x1, y1)): x1 and y1 are exclusive. Same call as src/sitewatch/experiments/vlm_compare/prepare.py.
no_extra_resize: This variant does not apply the floors max_side resize. The crop is the image the model would see.
coordinate_transform: A point (x, y) on the crop maps to the original frame as (x + x0, y + y0). A box (x0c, y0c, x1c, y1c) maps as (x0c + x0, y0c + y0, x1c + x0, y1c + y0).
